english: This %1$s contains %2$s frames. AN Paint edits still images and does not preserve animation.
turkish: Bu %1$s, %2$s kare içeriyor. AN Paint durağan görüntüleri düzenler ve animasyonu korumaz.
linguistic_assessment: Durağan görüntüler versus animasyon preserves the explicit loss of animation; frame count remains a count-neutral numeral before kare.

english: This PNG has a separate default image. That image will be imported instead of the animated frames. Saving creates a still image.
turkish: Bu PNG\'nin ayrı bir varsayılan görüntüsü var. Hareketli kareler yerine bu görüntü içe aktarılır. Kaydetmek durağan bir görüntü oluşturur.
linguistic_assessment: Separate default PNG image is distinguished from animated frames, and saving is expressly still-only; PNG apostrophe suffix is Android-escaped.

english: Only the first frame will be imported. Saving creates a still image.
turkish: Yalnızca ilk kare içe aktarılır. Kaydetmek durağan bir görüntü oluşturur.
linguistic_assessment: Yalnızca ilk kare retains first-frame restriction and the second sentence retains the still-output consequence.
Hareketli görüntü naturally names the animated-image warning rather than promising editable animation.

english: This %1$s is too complex to confirm whether it contains multiple frames. AN Paint will open only a still image and will not preserve any animation.
turkish: Bu %1$s, birden çok kare içerip içermediğini doğrulamak için fazla karmaşık. AN Paint yalnızca durağan bir görüntü açar ve animasyonu korumaz.
linguistic_assessment: İçerip içermediğini doğrulamak preserves uncertainty about multiple frames; the definite still-only/no-animation policy remains separate.

english: Writes plain text using light and dark characters. View it in a monospaced font. This is a visual rendition; it cannot be reopened as the original image.
turkish: Açık ve koyu karakterlerle düz metin yazar. Eş aralıklı bir yazı tipiyle görüntüleyin. Bu görsel bir temsildir; özgün görüntü olarak yeniden açılamaz.
linguistic_assessment: Düz metin and eş aralıklı yazı tipi express text output and monospaced viewing; the final clause forbids reopening as the original image.

english: %1$s exported. Your full drawing still has unsaved changes; save a full image copy before replacing it.
turkish: %1$s dışa aktarıldı. Tam çiziminizde hâlâ kaydedilmemiş değişiklikler var; değiştirmeden önce tam görüntü kopyasını kaydedin.
linguistic_assessment: Full-drawing unsaved state and save-a-full-copy-before-replacement warning are preserved; only catalogue semantics are assessable because no current production consumer was found.
Durağan görüntüyü aç is a natural affirmative action for accepting animation flattening.

english: PDF pages are rendered at 144 dpi. Text and vector objects become pixels.
turkish: PDF sayfaları 144 dpi\'de oluşturulur. Metin ve vektör nesneleri piksele dönüştürülür.
linguistic_assessment: 144 dpi remains exact and text/vector-to-pixel conversion is explicit; oluşturulur is understandable rendering language in this PDF context.

english: The image credits could not be saved or restored. Existing saved credits have been kept. Try again.
turkish: Görüntülere ilişkin atıf bilgileri kaydedilemedi veya geri yüklenemedi. Önceden kaydedilmiş atıf bilgileri korundu. Yeniden deneyin.
linguistic_assessment: Atıf bilgileri correctly means attribution/credits, with both failed save/restore and preservation of existing records, followed by retry.

english: These image credits would make the drawing too large to restore. Your previous drawing and credits have been kept.
turkish: Görüntüye ilişkin bu atıf bilgileri, çizimi geri yüklenemeyecek kadar büyütecektir. Önceki çiziminiz ve atıf bilgileriniz korundu.
linguistic_assessment: Conditional future büyütecektir describes the proposed excessive credits; previous drawing and credits are expressly retained.

english: Some saved credits could not be read. Their stored copies have been kept.
turkish: Kaydedilmiş bazı atıf bilgileri okunamadı. Saklanan kopyaları korundu.
linguistic_assessment: Some unreadable saved attribution records are distinguished from their retained stored copies.

english: The completed image could not replace its destination.
linguistic_assessment: Hedefinin yerini alamadı conveys failure to replace the destination in the rename-to-file consumers; adding dosya would be clearer but is not required to fix a demonstrated meaning error.

english: The image and encoding buffers exceed the export memory budget.
turkish: Görüntü ve kodlama arabellekleri dışa aktarma bellek sınırını aşıyor.
linguistic_assessment: Görüntü ve kodlama arabellekleri identifies both memory contributors; bellek sınırı accurately expresses the export budget.
Dosya biçimi is the standard file-format label for the format selector.
Dosya Adı correctly identifies the filename field; title capitalization is stylistic, not a meaning defect.

english: Still image, up to 256 colours. Dithering smooths colour gradients. Animated GIFs open as their first frame.
turkish: Durağan görüntü, en fazla 256 renk. Titreme, renk geçişlerini yumuşatır. Hareketli GIF\'ler ilk kareleriyle açılır.
linguistic_assessment: Still output, 256-colour ceiling, gradient smoothing and first-frame GIF import all remain; Titreme has attested Turkish GIMP dithering usage, so its everyday shaking sense is not sufficient reason to replace it.

english: Enter a file name without slashes or control characters.
turkish: Eğik çizgi veya denetim karakteri içermeyen bir dosya adı girin.
linguistic_assessment: Eğik çizgi and denetim karakteri correctly name forbidden slash/control characters in the filename validation error.

english: Higher quality preserves more detail and usually makes a larger file.
turkish: Daha yüksek kalite daha fazla ayrıntıyı korur ve genellikle daha büyük dosya oluşturur.
linguistic_assessment: Detail retention and usually-larger output retain the English qualification genellikle.
Farklı kaydet is the conventional Save as command and preserves the dialog ellipsis.

english: This image uses a colour profile that AN Paint cannot convert yet. Convert it to sRGB PNG in a colour-managed editor before importing.
turkish: Bu görüntü, AN Paint\'in henüz dönüştüremediği bir renk profili kullanıyor. İçe aktarmadan önce renk yönetimli bir düzenleyicide sRGB PNG\'ye dönüştürün.
linguistic_assessment: Henüz retains the converter limitation, sRGB PNG and colour-managed-editor remedy are intact, and no unsupported-format assumption is added.

english: %1$s A separate recovery copy has been kept. Use File > Export recovery copy to save its ZIP. Extract canvas.png from it and load that image to use the normal resize options if needed.
turkish: %1$s Ayrı bir kurtarma kopyası saklandı. ZIP dosyasını kaydetmek için Dosya > Kurtarma kopyasını dışa aktar seçeneğini kullanın. Gerekirse normal yeniden boyutlandırma seçeneklerini kullanmak için içindeki canvas.png dosyasını çıkarıp bu görüntüyü açın.
linguistic_assessment: Separate recovery copy, ZIP export path, exact canvas.png extraction and optional normal resizing all remain, including the prefixed failure reason.

english: An assembly source image is missing.
linguistic_assessment: Bileşimin kaynak görüntülerinden biri eksik naturally describes a missing assembly source without claiming the output is missing.
Bileşim kaydedildi correctly reports assembly output save success in saveOutput.

english: A source image needs more decoding memory than is currently available, even for a tiny output. Reducing the assembly dimensions cannot solve this. Close other documents or prepare a smaller source image before trying again. Your assembly is unchanged.
turkish: Bir kaynak görüntü, çok küçük bir çıktı için bile şu anda kullanılabilir olandan daha fazla kod çözme belleği gerektiriyor. Bileşim boyutlarını küçültmek bunu çözmez. Yeniden denemeden önce diğer belgeleri kapatın veya daha küçük bir kaynak görüntü hazırlayın. Bileşiminiz değişmedi.
linguistic_assessment: Even-tiny-output decoding memory floor, ineffectiveness of reducing dimensions, both remedies and unchanged assembly are all preserved.
Failure status is followed by the imperative Kaydet'i kullanın, preserving the manual-save remedy.
The compressed diagnostic still identifies image encoding during autosave and its failure, not a user-selected setting.

english: %1$s Autosave is paused to protect that draft. Use “File → Export recovery copy…” to keep it, and “File → Save as…” (File format: PNG / JPEG) to save your current work.
turkish: %1$s Bu taslağı korumak için otomatik kaydetme duraklatıldı. Saklamak için “Dosya → Kurtarma kopyasını dışa aktar…” seçeneğini, mevcut çalışmanızı kaydetmek için “Dosya → Farklı kaydet…” (Dosya biçimi: PNG / JPEG) seçeneğini kullanın.
linguistic_assessment: Paused autosave protects the previous draft; recovery export and Save as for the current work remain distinct with PNG/JPEG options.
Meta verileri eksik accurately identifies missing autosave metadata rather than missing image pixels.
Duraklatıldı denotes paused autosave, distinct from failure, while retaining manual Save guidance.
Pikselleri eksik accurately distinguishes absent autosave pixels from unreadable present bytes.

english: Autosave pixels could not be read.
linguistic_assessment: Okunamadı correctly reports inability to read the autosaved pixels without inventing a cause.
Seçimi kodlaması is compressed but identifies selection encoding in autosave; no change is needed to its failure meaning.

english: Cannot create the undo cache. Free some device storage and try again.
turkish: Geri alma önbelleği oluşturulamıyor. Cihazda biraz depolama alanı açıp yeniden deneyin.
linguistic_assessment: Geri alma önbelleği correctly names the Undo cache, and depolama alanı accurately requests device storage rather than RAM.
Tümünü temizle expresses clearing all assembly items in the clear action; it does not promise deletion of original files.
Görüntüyü temizle matches clearing canvas content and is distinct from closing or removing a file.

english: Could not export the recovery copy
linguistic_assessment: Kurtarma kopyası dışa aktarılamadı correctly reports recovery-copy export failure.
Görüntü açılamadı is idiomatic, cause-neutral image-open failure across the import routes.
Görüntü kaydedilemedi is the correct cause-neutral image-save error prefix.
Bileşim kaydedilemedi preserves assembly save failure and the trailing supplied reason.
Bileşim saklanamadı conveys the internal assembly storage failure, distinct from the exported PNG.

english: %1$d × %2$d pixels (%3$.2f MP) exceeds the current safe editing budget of %4$.2f MP. AN Paint keeps the complete image in memory and reserves space for transforms and selections. Available memory determines this budget. The operation was stopped before allocating the oversized bitmap. No automatic resizing was applied.
turkish: %1$d × %2$d piksel (%3$.2f MP), geçerli %4$.2f MP güvenli düzenleme sınırını aşıyor. AN Paint görüntünün tamamını bellekte tutar ve dönüşümler ile seçimler için alan ayırır. Bu sınırı kullanılabilir bellek belirler. İşlem, aşırı büyük bitmap ayrılmadan önce durduruldu. Otomatik yeniden boyutlandırma uygulanmadı.
linguistic_assessment: Dimensions, megapixel budget, retained whole image, transforms/selections, memory dependence, preallocation stop and no-auto-resize clauses all survive; bitmap is an understandable technical loanword here.
Değişiklikleri at narrows legacy Discard to changes consistently with the live destructive prompt; no current production consumer was found for this key.
Değişiklikleri at explicitly discards edits and contrasts correctly with Düzenlemeye devam et in replacement confirmation.
Henüz kaydedilmedi accurately marks not-yet-saved draft state rather than a failed save.
Taslak geri yüklendi correctly names restoration of the draft.
Taslak kaydedildi correctly reports completed autosave, distinct from external file Save.

english: The export was created. Use Save or Save as to save the current image before continuing.
turkish: Dışa aktarma oluşturuldu. Devam etmeden önce geçerli görüntüyü kaydetmek için Kaydet veya Farklı kaydet\'i kullanın.
linguistic_assessment: Export-created state does not imply the current image is saved; Kaydet/Farklı kaydet and before-continuing guidance remain.

english: Export an icon, Base64 text or ASCII art. Exporting keeps the current image and its Save destination unchanged.
turkish: Bir simge, Base64 metni veya ASCII sanatı dışa aktarın. Dışa aktarma, geçerli görüntüyü ve Kaydet hedefini değiştirmez.
linguistic_assessment: Icon/Base64/ASCII export alternatives and both unchanged current image and unchanged Save destination are preserved.
Kurtarma kopyasını dışa aktar accurately names the recovery export command with an ellipsis.
The same recovery export wording naturally titles the copy chooser without ellipsis.

english: Higher quality usually makes a larger file. Lossless keeps every colour value.
turkish: Daha yüksek kalite genellikle daha büyük dosya oluşturur. Kayıpsız mod her renk değerini korur.
linguistic_assessment: Genellikle retains the qualified size claim; kayıpsız mod explicitly preserves every colour value.

english: The canvas was restored, but its undo history could not be read. The original draft has been kept as a recovery copy.
turkish: Tuval geri yüklendi ancak geri alma geçmişi okunamadı. Özgün taslak kurtarma kopyası olarak saklandı.
linguistic_assessment: Restored canvas, unreadable Undo history and original-draft recovery copy remain three distinct facts.
Geçersiz meta verileri correctly covers malformed or oversized autosave metadata without asserting pixel corruption.
Düzenlemeye devam et unambiguously retains editing instead of applying the destructive replacement.

english: Keeps pixels at the top left. Smaller canvas dimensions discard pixels beyond the right/bottom edge; Undo restores them.
turkish: Sol üstteki pikselleri korur. Daha küçük tuval boyutları sağ/alt kenarın dışındaki pikselleri atar; Geri Al bunları geri getirir.
linguistic_assessment: Sol üstteki pikselleri means the pixels already at the top left, narrowing what is preserved; the consumer anchors the entire retained raster at the top-left origin. Clarify that positioning while retaining right/bottom loss and Undo restoration.

english: Not enough memory for this operation. The assembly source files are retained.
turkish: Bu işlem için yeterli bellek yok. Bileşim kaynak dosyaları korunur.
linguistic_assessment: Insufficient memory and retained assembly source files both remain; the translation does not promise successful rendering.

english: Not enough memory to save in this format. Try PNG
turkish: Bu biçimde kaydetmek için yeterli bellek yok. PNG\'yi deneyin
linguistic_assessment: Format-specific insufficient-memory failure and suggested PNG alternative are accurately retained.
PNG kodlaması başarısız is an accurate concise compression failure, not save success.
The status clearly states that the earlier draft was kept for recovery.
Kurtarılan görüntü correctly names a recovered image as a fallback filename.

english: Recovery copy exported. Extract canvas.png from the ZIP and open it with File > Load image. The ZIP also contains draft settings and any floating selection.
turkish: Kurtarma kopyası dışa aktarıldı. ZIP\'ten canvas.png dosyasını çıkarın ve Dosya > Görüntü yükle ile açın. ZIP ayrıca taslak ayarlarını ve varsa yüzen seçimi içerir.
linguistic_assessment: The recovery instruction says Dosya > Görüntü yükle, but the actual Turkish menu uses Görüntü aç. Match that command exactly while preserving ZIP extraction, canvas.png, draft settings and optional floating selection.
The passive question Büyük görüntü yeniden boyutlandırılsın mı? is natural confirmation for resizing a large image.

english: Estimates include the current canvas and clipboard, sampled decoding and editing buffers. Actual memory use varies. A smaller copy loses detail. The original file stays unchanged.
turkish: Tahminler geçerli tuvali ve panoyu, örneklenmiş kod çözmeyi ve düzenleme arabelleklerini içerir. Gerçek bellek kullanımı değişebilir. Daha küçük bir kopya ayrıntı kaybeder. Özgün dosya değişmeden kalır.
linguistic_assessment: Canvas/clipboard, sampled decoding and editing buffers, estimate variability, detail loss and unchanged original all remain; this is an exact previously tracked bounded receipt, not new review credit.
Kaydet correctly labels Save in image, palette and credit contexts.
The alias resolves to Kaydet; the live replacement prompt correctly invokes Save. Omitting the source ellipsis does not change the action meaning and is retained.
Kaydet ve paylaş preserves the save-then-share order and ellipsis.
Kaydet ve paylaş naturally titles the sharing save dialog.
The format placeholder moves before olarak kaydet, the natural Turkish order, preserving the Save-as format role; no current production consumer found.
JPEG olarak kaydet is correct format-specific Save wording; catalogue-only assessment of this legacy resource.
JPEG XL remains one format name in the correct Save-as command; catalogue-only assessment.
PNG olarak kaydet accurately names PNG output; catalogue-only assessment.

english: Choose an image format and its compression settings. Save will reuse this file name, location, format and settings.
turkish: Bir görüntü biçimi ve sıkıştırma ayarlarını seçin. Kaydet bu dosya adını, konumu, biçimi ve ayarları yeniden kullanır.
linguistic_assessment: The format/compression choice and reuse of filename, location, format and settings by Kaydet all remain.
PNG kaydet accurately describes saving the assembly PNG output, separate from editing it in Paint.
Değişiklikler Kaydedilsin mi? naturally asks whether to save changes; capitalization does not warrant a correction.
Filename followed by kaydedildi is natural Turkish save-success word order and retains the full inserted name.

english: Save a copy to your chosen location, then choose an app to share it. Your current Save destination stays unchanged.
turkish: Seçtiğiniz konuma bir kopya kaydedin, ardından paylaşmak için bir uygulama seçin. Geçerli kayıt konumu değişmez.
linguistic_assessment: Chosen-location copy, app chooser and unchanged current Save location all remain; kayıt konumu is suitable here.

english: The draft is saving. Try again shortly.
turkish: Taslak kaydediliyor. Kısa süre sonra yeniden deneyin.
linguistic_assessment: The draft is actively saving and retry should be shortly afterward; the wording does not imply failed completion.
Kodlayıcı tamamlayamadı is concise but correctly says the encoder could not finish; no additional cause is invented.

english: The image was saved, but Android could not open sharing: %1$s
turkish: Görüntü kaydedildi ancak Android paylaşımı açamadı: %1$s
linguistic_assessment: Saved image is explicitly distinguished from Android sharing failure, and the provided reason is retained.

english: The previous draft could not be moved to a recovery copy.
turkish: Önceki taslak bir kurtarma kopyasına taşınamadı.
linguistic_assessment: The previous draft could not be moved to a recovery copy; the translation preserves that failure without claiming a successful backup.

english: The previous draft could not be preserved separately.
linguistic_assessment: Ayrı olarak korunamadı correctly reports failure to preserve the previous draft separately.

english: The previous draft could not be restored.
linguistic_assessment: Geri yüklenemedi conveys prior-draft restoration failure without diagnosing corruption.

english: The previous draft needs more memory to reopen.
turkish: Önceki taslağı yeniden açmak için daha fazla bellek gerekiyor.
linguistic_assessment: Reopening the earlier draft needs more memory, correctly distinguished from storage capacity.

english: The saved assembly could not be opened: %1$s
linguistic_assessment: Saved assembly could not be opened, with the supplied reason after the colon; the target remains assembly-specific.

english: The selected location is not writable.
linguistic_assessment: Seçili konuma yazılamıyor correctly reports a nonwritable selected destination.

english: The trim would remove the entire image.
linguistic_assessment: The trim would remove the whole image; Turkish present-tense kaldırır expresses the conditional consequence at validation time.
Hasarlı correctly reports the Undo-cache integrity failure from header/hash validation.

english: There is not enough memory for this operation at the original resolution. No automatic resizing was applied.
turkish: Bu işlem için özgün çözünürlükte yeterli bellek yok. Otomatik yeniden boyutlandırma uygulanmadı.
linguistic_assessment: Insufficient memory at original resolution and no automatic resizing are both explicit.
Bu konuma yazılamıyor is the correct destination-write failure across recovery and source-code exports.

english: Unexpected data in the undo cache.
turkish: Geri alma önbelleğinde beklenmeyen veri var.
linguistic_assessment: Beklenmeyen veri accurately describes unexpected trailing Undo-cache data, without asserting a different failure.

english: Your current image has unsaved changes.
linguistic_assessment: The current image has unsaved changes; kaydedilmemiş preserves the required destructive-confirmation state.

english: The image colour converter could not start. The image was not imported.
turkish: Görüntü renk dönüştürücüsü başlatılamadı. Görüntü içe aktarılmadı.
linguistic_assessment: Converter startup failure and no imported image remain separate explicit facts.

english: The image has invalid or unsupported colour metadata.
turkish: Görüntünün renk meta verileri geçersiz veya desteklenmiyor.
linguistic_assessment: Geçersiz veya desteklenmiyor retains invalid-or-unsupported alternatives instead of asserting both.

english: The image ends inside its colour metadata.
turkish: Görüntü, renk meta verilerinin ortasında sona eriyor.
linguistic_assessment: The image data ends within its colour metadata; ortasında is idiomatic interruption wording and does not assert an exact halfway byte offset.

english: This image uses an ICC colour model that the image decoder cannot convert. Export an RGB copy in a colour-managed application first.
turkish: Bu görüntü, görüntü kod çözücünün dönüştüremediği bir ICC renk modeli kullanıyor. Önce renk yönetimli bir uygulamada RGB kopyası dışa aktarın.
linguistic_assessment: Unsupported ICC model and first exporting an RGB copy in a colour-managed application are preserved.

english: The original SVG size exceeds Android bitmap dimensions. No resizing was applied.
turkish: SVG’nin özgün boyutu Android bitmap boyut sınırlarını aşıyor. Yeniden boyutlandırma uygulanmadı.
linguistic_assessment: Original SVG size exceeds Android bitmap dimension limits and no resizing occurred; original-size semantics remain explicit.

english: The SVG does not declare a usable original size. No canvas-based size was substituted.
turkish: SVG kullanılabilir bir özgün boyut belirtmiyor. Yerine tuvale dayalı bir boyut kullanılmadı.
linguistic_assessment: No usable declared SVG original size and no canvas-derived substitute are both preserved.

english: This file exceeds the 512 MiB import limit. Choose a smaller file.
turkish: Bu dosya 512 MiB içe aktarma sınırını aşıyor. Daha küçük bir dosya seçin.
linguistic_assessment: The exact 512 MiB import ceiling and smaller-file remedy remain clear.
Uygulama dili correctly labels application language rather than device-wide language.
App-language status retains the exact supplied language name after the label.
Sistem dilini kullan naturally means follow the device/system language and fits the device-default picker row.
Ayarlar is the standard settings label.

english: App language\n\nTranslations are maintained in AN Paint’s language resources. New or untranslated text appears in English.
turkish: Uygulama dili\n\nÇeviriler doğrudan AN Paint\'in dil kaynaklarında tutulur. Bu katalog son güncellendikten sonra eklenen metinler geçici olarak uygulamanın temel İngilizce metnini kullanabilir.
linguistic_assessment: The target narrows fallback to text added after the last catalogue update and says it may be temporary. The source promises English for new OR untranslated text without that limitation; replace the full second paragraph accordingly.
Numeric selection dimensions, pixel unit, line break and rotation degrees preserve the source composition without language inflection.
100% is understandable mathematical zoom notation; Turkish convention also permits %100 in prose, but a notation-only change is unnecessary.
1 px is a conventional pixel-unit label; no current production consumer found.
One-decimal memory value plus unit preserves ordering and spacing; locale numeric formatting is controlled by the source consumer, not a translation change.
Gerçek boyut with %100 uses natural Turkish percentage order and means actual size; catalogue-only assessment.
Renk ekle accurately names adding a colour to a palette.
Metin ekle correctly commits the text object from the text dialog.
Sprey is a standard spray/airbrush tool term and matches the actual spray operation.
Tümü correctly selects all image checkboxes in the crop dialog.
Engelledi accurately attributes blocked file-picker access to Android, retaining the error reason.

english: Android could not decode this image.
linguistic_assessment: Görüntünün kodunu çözemedi is normal decoding language and does not imply cryptographic decryption in this image context.

english: Android could not find a file picker. Enable the Files or Documents app in Android settings, then try again.
turkish: Android bir dosya seçici bulamadı. Android ayarlarında Dosyalar veya Belgeler uygulamasını etkinleştirip yeniden deneyin.
linguistic_assessment: Missing picker, Android settings and enabling Files/Documents followed by retry are all retained.
Uygula is the standard affirmative application action for numeric and placement dialogs.
Sınırları uygula correctly commits the chosen canvas bounds.
Kırpmayı uygula correctly commits the crop rather than opening its preview.
Taslak otomatik kaydediliyor expresses autosave in progress and preserves the waiting ellipsis.
Arka plan rengi is the established background-colour term.
Arka plan plus hex value and Rengi düzenle correctly describe editing the background target.
Temel renkler correctly identifies the basic colour palette group.

BG is an English initialism while the matching accessible label is Arka plan. Its local comprehensibility as a tiny swatch caption has not been established; retain pending independent terminology/layout-aware review rather than invent an abbreviation.
Kalın is the standard bold text style.
Alt correctly identifies the bottom crop edge.
Fırça is the established brush tool term.
Doldur is a natural concise bucket-fill action; the tool role and adjacent drawing context disambiguate it.
İptal is the standard cancel action and remains suitable across noncommitting dialog exits.
Tuval sınırları names the canvas-bounds editing operation.
Tuval boyutu labels the canvas-size command, with ellipsis indicating the dialog.
Tuval Boyutu correctly titles that dialog; title case is stylistic only.
Tuval yakınlaştırması identifies the canvas zoom control.
Tuval yakınlaştırması plus the current zoom value correctly composes the accessibility status.
Fırça correctly translates Brush for this legacy category resource; no live production consumer found.
Ekle naturally names the insertion category, including shapes and text.
Seçim correctly labels selection tools and the Edit selection group.
Ortalanmış describes centered alignment in horizontal or vertical text; no gender/number agreement issue arises.

english: Choose a smaller output copy. The source images and crop settings stay at their original resolution.
turkish: Daha küçük bir çıktı kopyası seçin. Kaynak görüntüler ve kırpma ayarları özgün çözünürlüklerinde kalır.
linguistic_assessment: Smaller output copy is distinguished from original-resolution sources and unchanged crop settings.
Daha küçük bir boyut seçin clearly requests a smaller output size.
En az bir görüntü seçin correctly enforces the nonempty crop/image selection prerequisite.

english: Choose dimensions no larger than the original.
turkish: Özgün boyuttan büyük olmayan boyutlar seçin.
linguistic_assessment: No dimension may exceed the original; the plural boyutlar keeps the width/height constraint.
Konum seç correctly opens a destination chooser and preserves ellipsis.

english: This format must decode its source image or source tiles before resizing. A smaller output may still exceed available memory.
turkish: Bu biçim yeniden boyutlandırmadan önce kaynak görüntüyü veya kaynak döşemelerini çözmelidir. Daha küçük çıktı bile kullanılabilir belleği aşabilir.
linguistic_assessment: Source image/tiles must be decoded before resizing; even smaller output may exceed memory. Çözmelidir is understandable with the decoding/memory context.
Renk paletini daralt accurately names collapsing a palette; legacy catalogue-only assessment.
Seçili is invariant and composes correctly with every category/tool noun; collapse tools/options remains explicit.
Araç kutusunu daralt correctly collapses the toolbox.
Renk followed by the supplied hexadecimal colour identifies a swatch accurately.

english: Colour palette. Tap for foreground; hold for background. Scroll for more colours.
turkish: Renk paleti. Ön plan için dokunun; arka plan için basılı tutun. Daha fazla renk için kaydırın.
linguistic_assessment: Tap for foreground, hold for background and scroll for more colours remain distinct actions, correctly mapped to their consumers.
Plural Renkler is idiomatic for the colour tab containing multiple operations; singular English Color does not require unnatural number matching.

turkish: Renk #%1$s. Ön plan için dokunun, arka plan için basılı tutun.
linguistic_assessment: The hex colour placeholder remains attached to # and tap/hold roles remain foreground/background respectively.
Seçimi uygula correctly commits a floating selection to the document.
Kopyala is the standard Copy action.
Tümünü kopyala correctly copies all displayed text/credits across the consumers.
Kırpma uygulanamadı is an accurate cause-neutral crop application failure.
Düzenleme tamamlanamadı preserves edit failure and the complete supplied explanation.
İşlem tamamlanamadı accurately serves the generic operation failure without claiming any specific cause.
Görüntü yerleştirilemedi is correct for failure to place an assembly image.
Görüntü hazırlanamadı accurately reports preparation/copy failure without falsely diagnosing unsupported format.
Filename before kırp is conventional concise Turkish command/title order; it avoids attaching a guessed case suffix to arbitrary filenames.
Görüntüyü kırp accurately opens image cropping.

english: Crop must stay inside the canvas.
linguistic_assessment: Crop must remain within canvas bounds; the location restriction is preserved.

english: Crop preview. Drag an edge or corner; drag inside to move the crop.
turkish: Kırpma önizlemesi. Bir kenarı veya köşeyi sürükleyin; kırpmayı taşımak için iç kısmı sürükleyin.
linguistic_assessment: Crop preview, resizing via an edge/corner, and dragging inside to move the crop remain separate instructions.
Seçime göre kırp accurately crops the canvas to the selected area.
Kes is the standard Cut action.
A numeral takes singular piksel in Turkish, so all counts including 1 remain grammatical; dimensions and MP value retain their roles.
Seçimi sil unambiguously deletes the selected content.
Tamam correctly closes/completes the various dialogs; its overlap with OK is conventional Turkish UI usage.
Taslak bekliyor accurately denotes queued autosave rather than already saved state.
Çizim is a natural noun tab label for Draw and agrees with the quoted paste-navigation path.
Yeniden çiz appropriately returns from navigation to drawing.
Çizim correctly names the Drawing category distinct from individual tool labels.

english: Drawing canvas. Pinch and move two fingers to zoom and pan. Navigate mode also pans with one finger.
turkish: Çizim tuvali. Yakınlaştırmak ve kaydırmak için iki parmağınızı sıkıştırıp hareket ettirin. Gezinme modu tek parmakla da kaydırır.
linguistic_assessment: Yakınlaştırmak için sıkıştırıp directs fingers together to zoom in. PaintCanvas increases zoom as finger span grows; name both spreading/closing for zoom and two-finger dragging for pan, retaining one-finger navigation.
Çizim ayarları correctly labels drawing settings and the dialog-opening ellipsis.
Çizim ayarları correctly titles the drawing-settings dialog.
Adding rengini clarifies that editing the background means colour, consistent with the other colour resources; catalogue-only assessment.
Tuval correctly labels the Canvas edit group.
Renk Düzenle is understandable edit-colour command language; capitalization is stylistic only.
Ön plan rengini düzenle accurately clarifies foreground-colour editing; catalogue-only assessment.
Çevir / Döndür preserves the distinction between reflection and rotation used by the child commands.
Elips is the correct geometric drawing-tool label and does not confuse drawing with ellipse selection.
İle ... arasında correctly conveys the supplied numeric range; both endpoints remain in order.
Pozitif bir boyut correctly requires positive size for normalization.

english: Enter a trim amount for every edge.
turkish: Her kenar için bir kırpma miktarı girin.
linguistic_assessment: Her kenar için correctly requests one trim amount for each edge.

english: Enter a whole number from %1$s to %2$s.
turkish: %1$s ile %2$s arasında bir tam sayı girin.
linguistic_assessment: Tam sayı explicitly preserves the whole-number requirement in addition to the range.
Dört ... tümünü retains the requirement to enter all four trim amounts.

english: Enter positive canvas dimensions within Android\'s coordinate range.
turkish: Android\'in koordinat aralığında pozitif tuval boyutları girin.
linguistic_assessment: Positive canvas dimensions and Android coordinate-range restriction are both preserved.
Pozitif boyutlar correctly requests positive dimensions without adding a different bound.

english: Enter positive dimensions no larger than the original.
turkish: Özgün boyutlardan büyük olmayan pozitif boyutlar girin.
linguistic_assessment: Positive dimensions no larger than the original are both explicit.

english: Enter positive dimensions that resolve to at least 1 pixel.
turkish: En az 1 piksele karşılık gelen pozitif boyutlar girin.
linguistic_assessment: The dimensions must resolve to at least one pixel; fractional-input conversion is not confused with a whole-number-only entry requirement.
Pozitif görüntü boyutları accurately validates image dimensions at creation/import.
Geçerli boyutlar is a suitable generic invalid-dimensions remedy.
Silgi is the standard eraser tool term.
Renk paletini genişlet accurately expands a palette; no live production consumer found.
Invariant seçili composes correctly with all selected tool names; genişlet is the correct opposing action to daralt.
Araç kutusunu genişlet correctly expands the toolbox.
Farklı dışa aktar is an understandable Export as counterpart to Farklı kaydet and is accurately used for derived outputs.
Damlalık is the established eyedropper colour-sampling term.

FG is an English initialism while accessible text says Ön plan. Retain pending independent assessment of localized compact captions; full accessible wording does not itself certify this visible abbreviation.
Sığdır is a natural compact Fit command; the view-fitting consumer distinguishes it from altering pixels.
Tüm tuvali görünüme sığdır explicitly identifies fitting the entire canvas into the viewport.
Görüntüyü sığdır correctly translates the legacy Fit image label; no current consumer found.
Görseli tuvale sığdır accurately resizes/fits the floating image to the canvas, distinct from viewport Fit.
Yatay çevir corresponds to the negative-X reflection consumer.
Dikey çevir corresponds to the negative-Y reflection consumer.
Yazı tipi is the standard font label.
Yazı tipi ailesi accurately names the font-family chooser for accessibility.

turkish: Ön plan %1$s, arka plan %2$s. %3$s renk paleti.
linguistic_assessment: The first two colour clauses are clear, but the grammatical role of the third palette placeholder cannot be established without a consumer. Keep the complete legacy composition open rather than approve an unknown adjective/state insertion.
Ön plan rengi is the established foreground-colour term.
Foreground hex value and edit-colour action compose naturally in Ön plan ... Rengi düzenle.
Serbest Seçim clearly names free-form/lasso selection rather than freehand drawing.
Cihazdan appropriately labels obtaining an image from the device picker and preserves ellipsis.
Metnin tamamı kopyalandı confirms that all text, not a selection only, was copied.
Yükseklik with parenthesized unit is correct in ordinary and normalization dimension controls.
Unit before cinsinden yükseklik is natural Turkish order; the inserted percentage/pixel unit remains explicit.
Yükseklikler is the correct plural Heights, but no live consumer was found; catalogue semantics only.
Onaltılık correctly identifies hexadecimal entry and #RRGGBB is preserved as a format identifier.
Düzenleme denetimlerini gizle accurately hides editing controls; catalogue-only assessment.
Görüntü is a suitable generic fallback image name when provider metadata is unavailable.
Ekle accurately translates legacy Insert; no current consumer found.
Tuvale görüntü ekle preserves both insertion target and image object, with ellipsis; catalogue-only assessment.
Geçersiz renk correctly describes invalid colour-field input.

Anahattı is not the standard separated spelling ana hattı and is imprecise for the serialized selection contour. Use Geçersiz seçim konturu, consistent with the existing Kontur shape vocabulary and the Path contour consumer.
Renkleri tersine çevir accurately names colour inversion, separate from geometric flips.
Eğik is a conventional Turkish italic-style label in the font-style context.
Diller correctly names the language picker entry.
Sol correctly identifies the left crop edge.
Sola hizalı accurately describes left-aligned horizontal text.
Sol ok: daralt accurately describes a left-arrow collapse control; no live consumer found.
Çizgi correctly names the line drawing tool.
Satır aralığı accurately labels line spacing; percentage unit remains intact.
Görüntü aç is idiomatic for opening/loading an image and is the actual File menu label that recovery guidance must match.
En-boy oranını kilitle correctly locks the aspect ratio.
Oranları kilitle correctly labels proportional scaling for floating selection.
Büyütme is suitable for magnification in a drawing-preview context and preserves the percent unit.
Ana could be an elliptical Main label but no consumer establishes what it modifies. Keep this legacy context/idiom question open rather than invent Ana sayfa or Ana menü.
Menü accurately translates Menu; no live consumer found.
Renkler accurately translates the legacy plural Colors menu label; no live consumer found.
Düzenle is the standard Edit menu title.
Dosya is the standard File menu title and matches the recovery/export paths.
Yardım is the standard Help menu title.
Görüntü works as the generic image filename fallback at the actual consumers, despite the historical menu key name.
Görünüm is the conventional View menu title.
Gezin naturally labels navigation mode; separate guidance may use the grammatical noun Gezinme without requiring exact inflection matching.
Yeni correctly opens the New image dialog with ellipsis.
Yeni renk correctly labels a new colour; catalogue-only assessment.
Yeni görüntü accurately titles new-document creation and does not promise resizing existing pixels.
Okunabilir görüntü verisi yok correctly reports no readable source image data.

english: Even the smallest output cannot fit this image’s decoder working buffers in the current memory budget. Cancel and use a smaller source image.
turkish: En küçük çıktı bile bu görüntünün kod çözücü çalışma arabelleklerini geçerli bellek sınırına sığdıramıyor. İptal edin ve daha küçük bir kaynak görüntü kullanın.
linguistic_assessment: Even minimum output cannot fit decoder working buffers, and Cancel/use-smaller-source guidance are preserved; the causal structure remains clear.
Yok clearly deselects all images in the paired Tümü/Yok checkbox controls; Hiçbiri would be a stylistic alternative.

english: Not enough memory to finish opening this image
turkish: Bu görüntüyü açmayı tamamlamak için yeterli bellek yok
linguistic_assessment: Insufficient memory to finish opening remains distinct from the earlier inspection failure.

english: Not enough memory to inspect this image
turkish: Bu görüntüyü incelemek için yeterli bellek yok
linguistic_assessment: İncelemek accurately describes image inspection before full opening.
Label plus integer value preserves the numeric-slider composition and avoids unnecessary inflection.
Tamam is the conventional Turkish OK acknowledgment.
Özgün boyut accurately restores the floating image's original dimensions.
Diğer görseller naturally describes other images in the insertion chooser and matches the paste remedy.
Kontur is established outline/contour terminology for the shape-style option.
Palet is the conventional colour-palette label.
Yapıştır is the standard Paste action.

english: Copy an area or use Draw → Insert → Other images.
turkish: Bir alanı kopyalayın veya Çizim → Ekle → Diğer görseller yolunu kullanın.
linguistic_assessment: Copy-an-area prerequisite and Çizim → Ekle → Diğer görseller path exactly match the live Turkish tab/category/chooser labels.
Kalem is the natural pencil-tool term in the drawing context.
Yüzde is the correct percentage unit; initial lowercase is stylistic, not a semantic issue.
Yüzde correctly supplies the spelled-out unit in dimension accessibility descriptions.
Sıkıştırma ve kaydırma describes pinch/pan generically without specifying zoom direction; no live consumer found and no directional-action acceptance is inferred.
Piksel is the standard pixel unit, naturally singular as a unit-selector label in Turkish.
Piksel supplies the unit at the start of the Turkish cinsinden ... accessibility phrase; uppercase does not create a grammatical defect in that composition.
Metin yerleştir correctly titles placing a text object onto the canvas.
Lütfen yeniden deneyin is an idiomatic polite retry instruction.

english: Please wait for the current operation.
linguistic_assessment: Explicitly waiting for the current operation to finish is a faithful clarification of Please wait for the current operation.
Çokgen is the standard polygon shape term.
Önizleme correctly labels the text preview region.
Tool, zoom, width, height and draft status retain their five roles, separators and line break; no target-language agreement is introduced.
Width by height and px retain the complete dimensions composition.
Hazır is a natural ready/idle status.
Dikdörtgen correctly names the rectangle drawing tool.
Dikdörtgen Seçim distinctly names rectangular selection, not the shape drawing tool.
Yinele is conventional Redo wording and contrasts with Geri Al.
Kaldır correctly removes the selected image from the assembly; it does not falsely instruct deletion of its external original file.
Siyah / beyaz accurately labels restoring the foreground/background default pair.
Kırpmayı sıfırla correctly resets crop margins to the original full-image rectangle.
Siyah / beyaza sıfırla conveys restoring black/white defaults; catalogue-only assessment.
Yeniden boyutlandır ve yükle preserves resize-then-load ordering and is distinct from saving the original file.
Görüntüyü yeniden boyutlandır accurately opens image resizing, not canvas-only size editing.
Görüntüyü Ölçekle correctly titles this stretch=true scale-image dialog; the different wording from the menu is synonymous and matches behavior.
Kopyayı yeniden boyutlandır accurately specifies resizing a copy, preserving original-file semantics.
Sağ correctly identifies the right crop edge.
Sağa hizalı accurately names right-aligned horizontal text.
Döndür correctly labels the rotation handle in both horizontal and vertical rendering paths.
180° döndür retains the exact rotation angle.
Saat yönünde 90° döndür correctly preserves clockwise direction and angle.

english: Scales the image. Unlock the ratio to stretch width and height independently.
turkish: Görüntüyü ölçekler. Genişlik ve yüksekliği bağımsız değiştirmek için oran kilidini açın.
linguistic_assessment: Scaling the image and unlocking the ratio for independent width/height changes both remain; değiştirmek adequately describes stretching in this context.
Tümünü seç is the standard Select all action.
Bir alan seç is a concise instruction for the empty selection-dimensions state.
Önce bir alan seçin preserves the prerequisite before crop/delete/copy/cut operations.
Seçili renk accurately identifies the selected-colour preview.
Seçim boyutları çok büyük correctly reports oversized transformed selection dimensions.
Kaydedilen görüntüyü paylaş correctly labels sharing the already-saved image.
Tümünü göster is natural for fitting/showing the whole assembly in view.
Denetimleri göster accurately restores editor controls from fullscreen.
Düzenleme denetimlerini göster faithfully translates Show editor controls; catalogue-only assessment.
Büyütülmüş çizim önizlemesini göster accurately toggles the enlarged drawing preview.
Boyut (piksel) correctly labels the text size measured in pixels.
Boyut (px) correctly labels brush/pencil size and preserves the unit abbreviation.
Doldur conveys the filled-interior option when contrasted with Kontur and the fill-plus-line option; adding a solid qualifier is not required to distinguish the actual choices.

Renkleri değiştir can mean change colours generally, whereas the consumer exchanges foreground/background. Renklerin yerini değiştir explicitly expresses exchanging their positions; the full paired source values and swap implementation support this proposal. Layout remains untested.

Ön plan / arka planı değiştir can mean editing the two colours rather than exchanging them. Ön plan ile arka plan renklerinin yerini değiştir explicitly names the exchange. This is a catalogue-only correction proposal: no current consumer or width acceptance is claimed.
Önce bir görüntüye dokunun clearly requires selecting an image first.
Yazmak için / tuvale dokunun is natural Turkish instruction order and preserves the intended two-line layout break.
Label, value and tap-to-enter-number instruction compose naturally, without changing the numeric action.
Metin correctly names the text tool.
Metin hizalaması accurately labels text alignment.
Metin yönü accurately labels text direction including horizontal/vertical options.

english: The crop must contain at least one pixel.
turkish: Kırpma en az bir piksel içermelidir.
linguistic_assessment: En az bir piksel retains the nonempty crop prerequisite exactly.

english: The crop must stay inside the image.
linguistic_assessment: The crop must remain inside the image, correctly distinguished from the separate canvas-bounds error.

english: The decoder and editing buffers need about %1$s; the current safe editing budget is %2$s. Choose a smaller copy.
turkish: Kod çözücü ve düzenleme arabellekleri yaklaşık %1$s gerektiriyor; geçerli güvenli düzenleme sınırı %2$s. Daha küçük bir kopya seçin.
linguistic_assessment: Approximate memory need, current safe editing budget and smaller-copy remedy retain both supplied memory values and their roles.

english: The full image and working buffers exceed the current safe budget, or Android could not allocate them. Resize a copy to edit it. Your original file will stay unchanged.
turkish: Tam görüntü ve çalışma arabellekleri geçerli güvenli sınırı aşıyor veya Android bunları ayıramadı. Düzenlemek için bir kopyayı yeniden boyutlandırın. Özgün dosyanız değişmeden kalır.
linguistic_assessment: Android bunları ayıramadı can mean could not separate these objects; the actual alternative is memory allocation failure. Say bunlar için bellek ayıramadı, preserving the budget-exceeded alternative, smaller-copy remedy and unchanged original.

english: The picker returned no file. Please choose the file again.
turkish: Seçici dosya döndürmedi. Lütfen dosyayı yeniden seçin.
linguistic_assessment: Picker returned no file and choosing it again are both explicit; no unrelated provider failure is asserted.
Hiçbir dosya accurately reports no files from the assembly picker.

english: The selected provider did not return any image data.
linguistic_assessment: Seçili sağlayıcı görüntü verisi döndürmedi correctly reports absent image data from the selected provider.

english: This file is not a supported image. Use PNG, JPEG, JPEG XL, WebP, HEIC, AVIF, BMP, GIF, DIB, TIFF, ICO, PDF or Base64 image text.
turkish: Bu dosya desteklenen bir görüntü değil. PNG, JPEG, JPEG XL, WebP, HEIC, AVIF, BMP, GIF, DIB, TIFF, ICO, PDF veya Base64 görüntü metni kullanın.
linguistic_assessment: Unsupported-image diagnosis and every allowed format, including JPEG XL and Base64 image text, are preserved without added restrictions.
Tolerans is the established fill tolerance term for the slider.

english: Too large for the current budget. Reduce the dimensions or cancel and free memory.
turkish: Geçerli sınır için çok büyük. Boyutları küçültün veya iptal edip bellek boşaltın.
linguistic_assessment: Current budget exceeded, reduce dimensions, or cancel and free memory remain distinct remedies.

english: Tool categories. Scroll to see more tools
turkish: Araç kategorileri. Daha fazla araç için kaydırın
linguistic_assessment: Araç kategorileri and scrolling to see more tools preserve both identification and action guidance; catalogue-only assessment.

english: Trim amounts must be zero or greater.
turkish: Kırpma miktarları sıfır veya daha büyük olmalıdır.
linguistic_assessment: Sıfır veya daha büyük preserves the nonnegative trim requirement.

english: Trim amounts must fit inside each image; use whole pixels or percentages.
turkish: Kırpma miktarları her görüntünün içinde kalmalıdır; tam piksel veya yüzde kullanın.
linguistic_assessment: Per-image bounds and whole-pixel-or-percentage options are preserved; the target does not require whole percentages.
Dokunarak ... kırp / genişlet preserves touch-based trimming/expansion of canvas; catalogue-only assessment.

english: Please try a different file or location.
turkish: Lütfen farklı bir dosya veya konum deneyin.
linguistic_assessment: Farklı bir dosya veya konum correctly preserves both possible retry alternatives.
Metin yaz is a natural text-entry hint.
Altı çizili is the standard underlined text style.
Geri Al is conventional Undo wording; title capitalization is not a linguistic defect.
Başlıksız is the natural untitled-document fallback name.
The exact 1–1024 pixel range is preserved with grammatically singular piksel after numerals.
%50–300 follows Turkish percentage placement while preserving the exact supported interval.
Pozitif bir hedef boyut correctly requires a positive normalization target dimension.
Rengi kullan accurately applies the chosen colour instead of adding a palette entry.
#RRGGBB kullan preserves the required hexadecimal syntax and gives a natural imperative.
Suluboya is the established watercolor tool term.
Genişlik with a parenthesized unit correctly labels width in both dimension interfaces.
İşleniyor is an idiomatic operation-in-progress status for assembly, editor and credit export.
Yakınlaştır correctly means zoom in and corresponds to the scale-increasing consumer.
Uzaklaştır correctly means zoom out and corresponds to the scale-decreasing consumer.
